title: WebSec Evaluation Case
description: One labeled case the framework measures itself against, distilled from a public dataset (or a manual entry). Cases belong to the FRAMEWORK, not to one campaign: the repo-level eval store (src/webv2/eval_store.py) keeps them in eval/cases.json with a sha256 sidecar, so a hand edit is detectable drift. Provenance is mandatory (sprint constraint 5): the source dataset + record id (+ url when the source has one), the ingestion stamp (created_at, stamped by add_case), and schema_version. The leakage partition (sprint constraint 4) states which evaluation split the case belongs to; 'held-out'/'training' cases are eval-only data and never surface as proposer context or promotable memory.

dataset.description: which public dataset (or manual entry) the case was distilled from

record_id.description: the record's id WITHIN the source dataset, verbatim (commit hash, incident slug, case number, ...) — the only bridge back to the raw record

url.description: the source record's public URL, when the dataset has one

partition.description: leakage partition (sprint constraint 4): 'dev' behaves like today's shared rows; 'held-out' and 'training' are evaluation data that must NEVER surface in proposer-context negative-memory injection and must NEVER be promotable. add_case stamps 'dev' when the caller omits it.

program.description: the audited program's name — same field the bounty policy carries, so program-key derivation (shared_memory._program_key) can key eval metrics by program

platform.description: bounty platform, when known (e.g. immunefi, cantina, sherlock)

chains.description: chains the program's contracts live on

outcome.description: the adjudicated ground truth for this case

bug_class.description: a canonical taxonomy class OR the literal 'unmapped' — never a raw dataset label; the taxonomy map layer (webv2.taxonomy.normalize_class) resolves those

severity.description: the dataset's severity label, when it states one

root_cause.description: one-paragraph root cause in the dataset's own words, enough to adjudicate a hypothesis against

locations.description: where the bug lives, when the dataset points at code

repo.description: the affected code repository (url or owner/name)

commit.description: the exact commit the gold label was adjudicated against, when known

files.description: repo-relative paths of the affected files

snapshot_note.description: how the code snapshot was obtained/pinned for this case, when it matters for reproducibility

created_at.description: the ingestion stamp (sprint constraint 5): when this case entered the store; add_case stamps it when the caller omits it

schema_version.description: record shape version (sprint constraint 5): v2 = the dataset-ingestion sprint's evaluation-case shape

notes.description: free-form adapter notes (dataset quirks, adjudication caveats)
